recommendations.claim: Barbell back squat is the primary loaded lower-body compound for rebuilding strength capacity in the cleared returning trainee.
recommendations.source: NSCA Essentials of Strength Training (4th ed.); Schoenfeld (2010) hypertrophy review
recommendations.reversibility: Regress to goblet squat if lumbar bracing degrades; revisit load if any posterior referral returns

payload.name: Barbell Back Squat
payload.detail: Neutral spine, controlled descent to parallel, drive through midfoot. Brace before unrack.

recommendations.claim: Conventional deadlift restores posterior-chain loaded hinge capacity at a load now permitted under clearance.
recommendations.source: McGill (2015) Low Back Disorders; NSCA Essentials (4th ed.)
recommendations.reversibility: Regress to trap-bar or RDL if setup position is compromised; reduce load on any technique breakdown

payload.name: Conventional Deadlift
payload.detail: Hips set, lats engaged, bar over midfoot. Reset each rep. Stop the set on any spinal flexion under load.

recommendations.claim: Low-incline dumbbell press preserves upper-body pressing volume within a horizontal vector.
recommendations.reversibility: Reduce angle or load on any shoulder impingement signal

payload.name: Low-Incline Dumbbell Press (30 deg)
payload.detail: Controlled descent, neutral wrist, elbows ~45 deg flare.

recommendations.claim: Chest-supported row builds horizontal pulling volume without axial spinal loading.
recommendations.reversibility: Switch to seated cable row if bench contact is lost

payload.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
payload.detail: Chest stays on pad, retract scapula before pulling.

recommendations.claim: Walking lunge adds single-leg loaded volume and unilateral hip-extensor work.
recommendations.source: Andersen et al. (2015) glute activation review; NSCA Essentials (4th ed.)
recommendations.reversibility: Regress to split squat (static) if balance or pelvic control degrades

payload.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
payload.detail: Torso upright, knee tracks toe, push through front heel.

recommendations.claim: Captain's-chair knee raise trains anterior trunk under controlled flexion demand.
recommendations.reversibility: Regress to dead-bug if lumbar control is lost at end range

payload.name: Captain's-Chair Knee Raise
payload.detail: Posterior pelvic tilt, no swinging, controlled lower.
